Add at top: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); function playBeep(freq, duration) { const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator(); const gain = audioCtx.createGain(); osc.frequency.value = freq; osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioCtx.destination); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime); osc.start(); osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration); } Use for thrust: call playBeep(200,0.05).
